set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.1; milestone-organization.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Acceptance retained; this audit did not run its proposed tests.

Remaining / next action: After compatibility/count/recovery, qualify public organization preview with transition exchange, independent readback and unknown/provenance refusals. The 1.0 facade continues to withhold organization capabilities.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Governing plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md (2026-09-19); ADR 0019. Key: preview; lane: next.

Scope: codec transition exchange, independent exchange-reader integration, pipeline examples, docs-site analysis guide, docs/refactor/evidence

Acceptance criteria:
1. New analyst runs a text miniature and an admitted real annotated-video recall from ordinary local input paths through library/CLI to reference+reconstruction mapping tables and the independent consumer. No normal consumer imports bench.
2. Configuration resolved once; source reused across two recall inputs without rewriting its identity. Offline replay forbids network and yields deterministic scientific payloads; provider failure remains one typed participant/unit outcome.
3. Require reference-compatible organization readouts, per-unit and per-transition coverage and exact support/receipt joins. Declare annotation-assisted origin, inference grain and uncalibrated status. Do not claim automatic visual understanding or independent empirical recovery.
4. Crash/partial-write/digest mutations cause incomplete output refusal. Execution completion, structural validity and requested capability readiness are separate. No media/prose leaks into committed logs.
5. Commit command/config/input/output hashes, platform, totals and one reader walkthrough; private artifacts remain local. This gate is not D1A-film, V1, or the stable 1.0 release.

Validation: proposed pipeline public recall-map invocation + offline replay + independent reader; docs-site executable example

Completion evidence: exact baseline/result SHA, executable command and bound test totals/exit, artifact digests, discriminating failure injection, compatibility impact, separate SD6 review. Run reference-scope for the actual diff and SD2 checkAll before landing. Proposed suite names below are acceptance specifications, not existing or executed tests. No efficacy claim follows from a synthetic pass.

Boundary: This is the full G2 scientific-analysis preview milestone.

2026-09-22 operative workflow reconciliation (docs/plans/2026-09-22-recall-encoding-workflow.md):
Own the complete transition-exchange integration transferred from the base exchange ticket: implement transition-table serialization and checked manifest/reader joins, and independently recover the tiny backward/forward/same/unresolved answers. All original organization, compatibility, synthetic-recovery and fixed-denominator requirements remain. Basic mapping exports or temporal localization do not close this full scientific preview. The OpenNeuro scanner journey has its own clock/array qualification ticket; neither the closed ClockRepair integration nor this annotation-assisted preview certifies scanner alignment. Reference and reconstruction examples remain distinct and explicitly uncalibrated where applicable.
